ja: 『機動戦士ガンダムＵＣ』より、９４式ベースジャバーが１／１４４スケールＨＧＵＣで登場!
Ｈ Ｇ Ｕ Ｃ シ リ ー ズ Ｍ Ｓ（ 別 売 ） を 搭 載 し て 楽 し も う ！
『機動戦士ガンダムＵＣ』より、ジェガンなどの1/144ＭＳ（別売）を搭載し、動きのあるディスプレイを演出して楽しめる
94式ベースジャバーを商品化。
特徴的な大型スラスターの形状を忠実に再現し、表面のディテールや、グリップ形状、位置選択式のニーレストなどの
細部表現も再現。

en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam UC", Type 94 Base Jabber is now available in 1/144 Scale HGUC!
Equipped with HGUC series MS (sold separately) and have fun!
From "Mobile Suit Gundam UC", it is equipped with 1/144 MS (sold separately) such as Jegan, and you can enjoy a moving display.
Commercialized Type 94 Base Jabber.
The shape of the characteristic large thruster is faithfully reproduced, and the surface details, grip shape, position-selectable knee rest, etc.
Detailed expressions are also reproduced.
*Some MSs (sold separately) may not be able to be installed due to the shape of the legs.
1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 8 years old and above
Product material: PS
・No adhesive is used for assembly
《This product does not include the MS body》
*The finished product in the photo has a violet finish.
*The kit in the photo is a prototype that is still under development. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
(remarks)
・This product is a limited edition item.
*We may sell items at events sponsored by our company or other projects.
*Cannot be purchased at stores that carry plastic models.
・ There is a limited number of this product available for sale at 'Premium Bandai'.
Please note that the item may be out of stock.
・Product images are under development and may differ from the actual product.
